settings.helpers.label: Helpers
settings.helpers.body: A session here may ask another agent to answer one question: the helper reads, answers and changes nothing. This says whether such an ask waits for your yes, starts at once within the limits, or is not offered, and which agents may be asked, in the order they are tried. Your own press asks one whatever this says. A repository's rule replaces its workspace's whole.
settings.helpers.says.ask: Each helper an agent asks for waits for your yes.
settings.helpers.says.on: A helper an agent asks for starts at once, within the limits: two at once for a session, one turn each.
settings.helpers.says.off: A helper is not offered to a session here: only your own press asks one.
settings.helpers.says.agentsMany: Only {{agents}}, may help, tried in that order unless the session names one of them.
settings.helpers.says.anyAgent: No agent is named here, so a session may ask any: the one it names, else another maker's agent.
settings.helpers.says.setUpAgents: Only Daoris's own agents are asked, those it has set up and signed in on this machine: the one the session names, else another maker's; one it names that is not among them is refused with the reason.
settings.helpers.mode: What a helper an agent in {{name}} asks for does
settings.helpers.agents: The agents {{name}}'s sessions may ask, in the order they are tried
settings.helpers.saved.ask: A helper an agent in {{name}} asks for now waits for your yes.
settings.helpers.saved.on: A helper an agent in {{name}} asks for now starts at once, within the limits.
settings.helpers.saved.off: Helpers are not offered to sessions in {{name}} now.
settings.helpers.cleared: {{name}} takes its helpers rule from what stands above it again.
